Hi Ellie —

Great to meet you on yesterday's call. We're excited to get Arcadian Labs set up so we can issue a PO and start the first pilot credits. To get procurement moving I need the attached buyer intake form completed and the vendor banking/tax details below:

- Legal entity name (exact as on W-9 or local tax form)
- Registered address (street, city, state/province, country)
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT ID for non-US)
- Remit-to address (if different)
- Preferred payment method: ACH (US) or Wire
- If ACH: bank name, account number, routing number, account type (checking/savings)
- If Wire: bank name, SWIFT/BIC, IBAN (if applicable), beneficiary name and address

I've attached our buyer intake PDF — please complete and return with a signed W-9 or equivalent. If you prefer to upload documents to the shared folder, send the link and we'll pick them up.

Timeline: if we can get the completed form + W-9 by EOD Friday (5/29) we should be able to issue the PO by the following Wednesday and schedule the pilot delivery.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
